metaTitle: Move-Out Cleaning in Long Beach, CA | Cost & What's Included
metaDescription: Move-out cleaning in Long Beach costs $255 to $480. See what's included, when to DIY, and what drives the price for duplexes, bungalows, and condos.
intro: Moving out of a Long Beach rental means the unit has to be left clean enough to satisfy a landlord or property manager, whether that's a 1920s bungalow, a duplex unit, or a waterfront condo near Belmont Shore. Move-out cleaning covers the deep cleaning most tenants skip during regular upkeep, and it's often the difference between getting a full security deposit back or not.
causes: Regular cleaning during a tenancy usually skips inside appliances, baseboards, and window tracks, so grease and dust build up over months or years.
Older Long Beach duplexes and bungalows often have original tile, hardwood, or single-pane windows that trap grime in grooves and corners standard cleaning misses.
Kitchens accumulate stovetop and oven residue, and bathrooms develop soap scum and hard water spots, especially in units with older plumbing.
Waterfront condos near the water can pick up salt air residue on windows, screens, and balconies that regular indoor cleaning doesn't address.
Move-out inspections check specific items like closet interiors, under sinks, and light fixtures that day-to-day cleaning generally ignores.
whatProDoes: Cleans and degreases kitchen surfaces including inside the oven, refrigerator, and cabinets, inside and out.
Scrubs bathroom tile, grout, fixtures, and removes soap scum and mineral deposits from showers and sinks.
Vacuums and mops all flooring, including closets, and wipes down baseboards, window sills, and window tracks.
Dusts light fixtures, ceiling fans, vents, and wipes interior doors and door frames.
Does a final walkthrough to check corners, cabinet interiors, and other spots landlords commonly inspect.
diyOrPro: If you have a few free weekends and the unit is small and in decent condition, a thorough DIY clean with the right supplies can work, especially for a studio or one-bedroom. For larger units, older properties with stubborn grime in grout or window tracks, or condos with a tight move-out deadline, a professional saves time and reduces the risk of losing part of your deposit over cleanliness disputes.
priceNote: This job runs $255 to $480 in Long Beach, based on $56 an hour with most jobs taking 4 to 8 hours. The total depends mainly on the size of the unit, how much buildup has accumulated over the tenancy, and whether extras like inside-appliance detailing or window track cleaning are needed.

faqs.q: Does move-out cleaning include the inside of the oven and refrigerator?
faqs.a: Yes, standard move-out cleaning includes degreasing the oven interior and wiping down the inside of the refrigerator, since these are common items landlords check during move-out inspections.

faqs.q: Will this guarantee I get my full security deposit back?
faqs.a: No cleaning service can guarantee that, since deposit decisions depend on the landlord's overall inspection, including wear and damage beyond cleanliness, but a thorough clean removes cleanliness as a reason to withhold funds.

faqs.q: How long does move-out cleaning take for a typical Long Beach unit?
faqs.a: Most jobs take 4 to 8 hours depending on the unit's size and condition, which is reflected in the $255 to $480 price range based on an hourly rate of $56.
